# Run Together Radcliffe (radcliffe.run)

> A free, friendly running club and group in Radcliffe, Bury, Greater Manchester,
> open to everyone. Part of the England Athletics Run Together programme.
> No membership fees, no minimum pace, no booking needed.

## The essentials

- When: every Thursday at 7:00pm (meet from 6:45pm)
- Where: Radcliffe Market, 11 Blackburn Street, Radcliffe, Manchester M26 1PN
- Cost: free, always
- Getting there: about a 10-minute walk from Radcliffe Metrolink stop (Bury line);
  limited parking in the Lidl car park and free parking nearby in the town centre
- No booking needed - just turn up. Registering emergency contact details at
  https://www.radcliffe.run/join is encouraged for safety.

## Groups (pick on the night)

- Get Me Started: 5-6k jeffing (run/walk intervals), no minimum pace - ideal for
  beginners or anyone returning from a break
- Keep Me Going: 5-6k steady running with regroups, around 6:15-7:30 min/km
  (10-12 min/mile)
- Challenge Me: 8-10k for more experienced runners, around 5:35-6:50 min/km
  (9-11 min/mile)

Routes are a mix of road and trail: road in the darker months, trails on lighter
evenings (hi-vis and lights needed in autumn and winter). Member-led social runs
also happen most weekends, and the club runs an NHS Couch to 5K programme
(https://www.radcliffe.run/c25k) when a cohort is open.

## Key pages

- About and FAQ: https://www.radcliffe.run/about
- Join (free registration): https://www.radcliffe.run/join
- Route library with maps and GPX downloads: https://www.radcliffe.run/routes
- Self-guided walks: https://www.radcliffe.run/walks
- News and weekly roundups: https://www.radcliffe.run/news
- Couch to 5K: https://www.radcliffe.run/c25k
- Contact: https://www.radcliffe.run/contact
